defaultEvidenceRetentionClass: public-listing-metadata: title, URL, description and publication date only, retained for one review cadence; no page body is stored.
defaultLicenseTermsReview: Track 1 reads the public listing page only, to record that a piece of content exists. It records title, URL and description, does not fetch or store course bodies, and does not authenticate or bypass any paywall. The host publishes this listing page for public indexing and its robots.txt permits a generic agent on this path.
note: Machine-gathered robots evidence decided the initial split: permitted means approved, disallowed or unreadable means held. Commercial terms of service are a separate judgement from robots.txt; strike any source here whose terms you read differently.
